tools.name: voodoosms_get_credits
tools.description: Get the SMS credit balance of the account. One credit pays for one 160-character SMS part (153 characters per part in a long message). Voodoo SMS REST: GET /credits.

tools.name: voodoosms_list_delivery_reports
tools.description: List delivery reports of sent messages (message_id, sender_id, to, sent_at, delivered_at, price, status), optionally filtered. Use it to check whether a message was delivered. Dates accept a UNIX timestamp, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T09:00:00+00:00) or plain English ('yesterday', '2 weeks'). Voodoo SMS RE

tools.name: voodoosms_list_scheduled_messages
tools.description: List SMS that were scheduled through the send API and are still waiting to go out (messages scheduled in the portal's Web SMS are not shown). Voodoo SMS REST: GET /schedule.

tools.name: voodoosms_list_inbox
tools.description: List SMS received on the account's Virtual Mobile Numbers (replies and keyword messages). Needs a purchased number; an empty inbox returns an empty result. Dates accept a UNIX timestamp, ISO 8601 or plain English. Voodoo SMS REST: GET /inbox.

tools.name: voodoosms_list_numbers
tools.description: List the Virtual Mobile Numbers (VMNs) the account has purchased, used to receive SMS. Returns an empty result if there are none. Voodoo SMS REST: GET /numbers.

tools.name: voodoosms_list_contact_lists
tools.description: List the account's contact lists (id, name, status, size, created/updated times) without their contacts. Returns an empty result if there are none. Voodoo SMS REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: voodoosms_get_contact_list
tools.description: Get one contact list including its contacts (id, number, status, dynamic_data, created_at). Voodoo SMS REST: GET /contacts?contact_list_id=.

tools.name: voodoosms_list_blacklist
tools.description: List the numbers on the account's opt-out blacklist (no SMS is ever sent to them), or look up one number (`{empty: true}` means it is not on the list). Returns an empty result when the blacklist is empty. Voodoo SMS REST: GET /blacklist.

tools.name: voodoosms_send_sms
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS A REAL SMS to ONE recipient and USES THE ACCOUNT'S CREDITS (1 credit per message part, charged whether or not it is delivered; it cannot be undone). `sandbox` is required: true validates and prices the message without sending or charging, false sends it for real. Optional `schedule` que

tools.name: voodoosms_cancel_scheduled_message
tools.description: WRITE: cancels one SMS that was scheduled through the send API, so it will not be sent. A message that has already gone out cannot be cancelled. Whether credits are refunded for a cancelled message is not documented by the vendor. Voodoo SMS REST: DELETE /schedule/{id}.

tools.name: voodoosms_add_to_blacklist
tools.description: WRITE: adds one number to the account's opt-out blacklist; from then on no SMS is sent to it (sends to it fail with error 20). Use it for a recipient who asked to stop. This tool cannot remove a number again. Voodoo SMS REST: POST /blacklist.

tools.name: voodoosms_create_contact_list
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new contact list with up to 500 contacts (the list name must be unique, at most 32 characters). It does not send anything. Voodoo SMS REST: POST /contacts.

tools.name: voodoosms_update_contact_list
tools.description: WRITE: renames a contact list and/or adds up to 500 contacts to it (existing contacts are not removed). Adding dynamic data needs a list created as dynamic. It does not send anything. Voodoo SMS REST: PUT /contacts/{contact_list_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: voodoosms_get_credits, voodoosms_list_delivery_reports, voodoosms_list_scheduled_messages, voodoosms_list_inbox, voodoosms_send_sms, voodoosms_create_contact_list · Private data: voodoosms_list_contact_lists, voodoosms_get_contact_list, voodoosms_create_contact_list, voodoosms_update_contact_list · Public sink: voodoosms_get_credits, voodoosms_list_delivery_reports, voodoosms_list_scheduled_messages, voodoosms_list_inbox, voodoosms_list_numbers, voodoosms_list_contact_lists, voodoosms_get_contact_list, voodoosms_list_blacklist, voodoosms_send_sms, voodoosms_cancel_scheduled_message, voodoosms_add_to_blacklist, voodoosms_create_contact_list, voodoosms_update_contact_list · Destructive: voodoosms_cancel_scheduled_message, voodoosms_add_to_blacklist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: voodoosms_get_credits, voodoosms_list_delivery_reports, voodoosms_list_scheduled_messages, voodoosms_list_inbox, voodoosms_send_sms, voodoosms_create_contact_list · Private data: voodoosms_list_contact_lists, voodoosms_get_contact_list, voodoosms_create_contact_list, voodoosms_update_contact_list · Public sink: voodoosms_get_credits, voodoosms_list_delivery_reports, voodoosms_list_scheduled_messages, voodoosms_list_inbox, voodoosms_list_numbers, voodoosms_list_contact_lists, voodoosms_get_contact_list, voodoosms_list_blacklist, voodoosms_send_sms, voodoosms_cancel_scheduled_message, voodoosms_add_to_blacklist, voodoosms_create_contact_list, voodoosms_update_contact_list · Destructive: voodoosms_cancel_scheduled_message, voodoosms_add_to_blacklist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
